chunks: And the Prophet, peace be upon him and his family, said:
"In this Ummah, there will be everything that occurred in the Children of Israel, exactly alike, step by step and feather by feather."

key_terms.بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ: the Children of Israel, the earlier community being compared to this Ummah
key_terms.حَذْوَ النَّعْلِ بِالنَّعْلِ: with exact likeness, as one sandal matches another
key_terms.حَذْوَ الْقُذَّةِ بِالْقُذَّةِ: with precise conformity, as one feather matches another

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith mean that this Ummah will follow Banī Isrāʾīl step by step?
ai.summary: The Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله says that this Ummah will experience counterparts to what befell Banī Isrāʾīl, with close resemblance and repetition. The hadith emphasizes historical recurrence and serves as a warning that patterns found in earlier religious communities may reappear in the Muslim community.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: "In this Ummah, there will be everything that occurred in the Children of Israel, step by step and inch by inch”.
